UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has recently published the official notification regarding the UPSSSC Online Time Registration (OTR) 2026 on the official website of UPSSSC. For which the details for UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration Online Form 2026 has been provided on this page. As per the notification released by the UPSSSC, it has been instructed to the aspirants who are applying for the upcoming vacancies in near future that they must have to complete their OTR Registration Process in website before applying for the UPSSSC New Vacancies. Candidates must check the complete details & process for UPSSSC OTR One Time Registration 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 July 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : NA

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST : 0/
  • No Application Fee for Any Candidates
  • Candidates only have to register themselves.

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
